input.question: What is the population of Port Vincent?

documents.text: Elevation 7 ft ( 2 m ) Population ( 2020 ) • Total 1,234 • Density 379.11/sq mi ( 146.41/km 2 ) Time zone UTC-6 ( CST ) • Summer ( DST ) UTC-5 ( CDT ) Area code 225 FIPS code 22-62105 Website portvincent-la.gov Port Vincent is a village in Livingston Parish, Louisiana, United States.
